string.name: about_ai_body
string.value: Each tour story was drafted with the help of an AI model from the sources listed with it, then checked and edited by a person. Places outside the tour use short descriptions from Wikipedia or Kraków's heritage register, shown as they are. Nothing you do in the app is sent anywhere. Stories, maps and voices are stored on your phone.

string.value: Polish and Chinese stories are machine-translated from the reviewed English and labelled as such.

string.name: onb1_title

string.value: Put your headphones in, lock your phone and walk. The Historian leads you through Kraków and tells you about each place as you reach it.

string.name: onb2_body
string.value: You can change this any time.
